name: Anua Heartleaf Pore Deep Cleansing Foam

desc:
The cleansing effect can feel a little drying if you already use several active treatments.
⭐ This gently exfoliates dead skin cells.
⭐ Leaves the skin feeling deeply clean and fresh.
✅ If your skin gets oily, congested or has blackheads, take this

name: Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Cleanser
apply: 💦 Wet your face → 🫧 Use a small amount → 🤲 Gently massage 20–30 sec → 🚿 Rinse.
desc:
Though it has a scent, this cleanser is very gentle and it cleans without leaving yoour skin dry or tight because it has hyaluronic acid.
⭐ Alcohol free
✅ Best if your oily skin but gets tight/dry after cleansing.

name: Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot
apply: 🌙 After cleansing → 💧 squeeze 1 pea sized amount of the cream on your hand → 🤲 Gently spread on the face areas with dark spots→ ⏳ Let it absorb.
desc:
Gently fades dark spots.
⭐ It absorbs nicely without leaving greasyness.
✅ Choose this if you want a gentle dark mark fading serum that gives a lovely glow.
👉 Use 1 time daily only in the morning

name: Purito Txa 6 Niacinamide Retinal Serum

desc:
A faster, easily absorbed dark spot clearing serum.
⭐ No greasy residue or scent.
✅ Best for stubborn dark marks, discoloration and rough skin texture.
👉 Use 3 times per week only at night

name: Purito Oat-in Calming Gel Cream
apply: 🧴 Put 2 pea-sized amount of the moisturizer on your hand  → 🤲 Spread gently on your face → ⏳ Let absorb.
desc:
Lightweight hydration without making your skin oil heavy.
⭐ Scent & Alcohol free.

name: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Soothing Cream
